name: 2026 Porsche 911 Carrera 4S · Systems
author: Jack Ingram demo contributors
scope: Original representative systems reconstruction. Public specification envelope; illustrative component shapes and positions. No OEM CAD, VIN stock, crash solver, wiring route or repair procedure.

sources.title: Porsche MY2026 Carrera 4S announcement
sources.scope: 2026 non-hybrid Carrera 4S: engine, PDK, PTM, brakes, wheels and seating. Facts only; no media imported.

sources.title: 2026 Carrera 4S technical specifications
sources.scope: Dimensions and engine figures; this European listing is not Jack Ingram stock.

sources.title: Porsche Traction Management architecture
sources.scope: General functional architecture; exact 992.2 routing and torque maps are not published here.

sources.title: Porsche 11/26 wheel and tire certificate
sources.scope: Non-hybrid 992PA 20/21-inch summer row. Wheel option and VIN still govern exact fitment.

sources.title: Type 992 mixed-material body production
sources.scope: 2019 architecture reference. Geometry, material gauges and 2026 effectivity are not certified.

sources.title: 992.II rear drive shaft rattle · 2509
sources.scope: As of MY2025, listed model types; noise condition, not a stated loss of drivability. Applicability requires model/equipment checks.

sources.title: Unapproved engine oil and GPF ash
sources.scope: 992.II OPF-equipped cars as of MY2025. Explanatory context, not a diagnosis.

sources.title: NHTSA 25V896000 / Porsche ASB2
sources.scope: Certain 2020–2025 911 vehicles; rear-view camera software recall. A 2026 illustration does not establish applicability.

sources.title: NHTSA 25V079000 / Porsche ASA1
sources.scope: Certain MY2025 911 vehicles; lighting-control software recall. Confirm VIN and repair status.
